visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a brown t-shirt featuring a cartoon character speaks directly to the camera against a plain white wall background. He gestures broadly with both hands, palms up, while smiling energetically, introducing the topic of the video with high enthusiasm. (2) The scene cuts to a top-down view of a white table surface where various packaged Japanese drugstore items, including boxes and plastic packets, are dropped rapidly from above, creating a messy but vibrant pile of consumer products in the center of the frame. (3) Close-up shots continue as more specific items like small eye drop containers, medicinal patches, and colorful supplement packets are tossed onto the growing pile. The lighting remains bright and even, emphasizing the detailed Japanese text and logos on the packaging throughout the sequence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic male voice speaks rapidly, introducing a recommendation list for Japanese drugstore products. The tone is extremely cheerful and welcoming, characterized by high vocal arousal, clear articulation, and a fast speech rate that conveys excitement to the listener immediately. (2) A rapid sequence of sharp, percussive thudding sounds begins, with each sound representing a different packaged item hitting a hard surface. The frequency of these impact events is high, creating a rhythmic and dense acoustic texture that matches the visual speed of the objects falling. (3) The percussive thuds continue with varying acoustic characteristics—some exhibit short, dry thuds like cardboard boxes, while others have a crinkly plastic texture. These sound events overlap slightly as the pile grows, maintaining a high density of transient sound effects throughout the final sequence.
